items.exampleEn: There is a small box of pills on the table.
This bus has space for a wheelchair.
items.exampleZh: 這輛公車有放輪椅的空間。

items.exampleEn: Strong sunlight can be harmful to old paintings.
items.exampleZh: 強烈的陽光可能會損害老畫作。

items.exampleEn: My son is afraid of the dentist.
My plants died because I forgot to give them water.
items.exampleZh: 我的植物枯死了，因為我忘了給它們澆水。

items.exampleEn: The story begins with the death of an old king.
items.exampleZh: 這個故事從一位老國王的死開始。

items.exampleEn: Scientists are working on a new drug for colds.
items.exampleZh: 科學家正在研發一種治感冒的新藥。

items.exampleEn: The doctor sees thirty patients a day.
items.exampleZh: 這位醫生一天看三十個病人。

items.exampleEn: The town needs more medical workers.
items.exampleZh: 這個小鎮需要更多醫療人員。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather keeps his pills in the kitchen.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺把他的藥丸放在廚房。

items.audioEn: The new hospital has two hundred beds for patients.

items.sentenceEn: Some plants are harmful to cats.
This drug is only for adults.

items.stemEn: My tooth hurts. I need to see a ____.
items.stemZh: 我牙齒好痛，我得去看牙醫。

items.stemEn: Some flowers ____ in the cold winter.
items.stemZh: 有些花在寒冷的冬天會枯死。

items.passageEn: Amy is a medical student. On weekends, she helps at a hospital. She pushes patients in wheelchairs and talks with them. She also helps the nurses carry things. Many of the patients are old and lonely. "Talking with them makes me happy," she says. After she finishes school, she wants to work in her hometown.
items.passageZh: Amy 是醫學系的學生。週末她會去醫院幫忙。她幫病人推輪椅、陪他們聊天，也幫護理師搬東西。很多病人年紀大了，又很寂寞。她說：「跟他們聊天讓我很開心。」畢業後，她想回家鄉工作。

questions.questionZh: Amy 覺得跟病人聊天怎麼樣？

items.promptZh: 這本書寫的是一位畫家的一生與死亡。
referenceEn: This book is about the life and death of a painter.
This book tells the life and death of a painter.
rubricZh: 「⋯的一生」可寫例如 the life of…；「寫的是」可寫例如 is about、tells

items.instructionZh: 用 medical 造一個句子，說說和醫學或醫療有關的人、地方或東西。
referenceEn: My sister wants to go to medical school.
This hospital has new medical machines.
rubricZh: medical 放在名詞前，表示「醫學的；醫療的」（例如 medical school、medical machines）
主詞和動詞要搭配（例如 This hospital has）
